headings.text: Telephone English: Phrases for Calls and Customer Care

paragraphs: Handle calls with confidence. Opening lines, putting people on hold, and closing — with Indian call-centre ready examples.
Phone English is its own skill. You cannot see the face, so clarity matters most.
"Good morning, SpeakNow customer care, Rupesh speaking. How may I help you?"
"May I put you on hold for a moment?" Never just stay silent.
"Let me connect you to the billing team."
"Thank you for calling. Have a great day."
"Could you please repeat that?" "Pardon?" "Could you speak a bit slower?"
Customer-care roles need clear phone English. Practise these lines daily with the SpeakNow read-aloud tool.
Smile while talking on the phone. It changes your tone and the listener feels it.
